seen_animation: A tall boxy black-line vehicle seen head-on, with a large arch on its face, a small chimney cap on top with two wavy smoke strokes, and small polygon wheels along the bottom, stands at left-centre. A small black stick figure stands to its right on the ground line. Frames 1-8: the vehicle holds roughly still while the smoke strokes wiggle and the stick figure starts walking left. Frames 9-12: the vehicle grows slightly and its right edge moves right while the figure walks left toward it. Frames 13-16: the vehicle keeps growing slowly and the figure arrives at its lower right corner and stands leaning against it. Grey scenery (clouds, a tall building outline, a low wagon with a chimney, horizon lines) is fixed behind; the building is progressively covered as the vehicle grows.
seen_film: A switching locomotive (number 53) seen from the front approaches the camera slowly across a rail yard, growing larger frame by frame and covering the tall white building on the right. A man in dark clothes stands to the right of the locomotive. Frames 1-8: he stands or steps slightly. Frames 9-12: he moves left toward the locomotive's front right corner and crouches/reaches for the step and handrail. Frames 13-16: he is up against the front right corner, holding on (boarding the step) as the locomotive keeps coming forward and grows to fill most of the frame.
named_subject: A locomotive (drawn as the doodle's boxy train with arch door, chimney, smoke and polygon wheels) approaching, with a stick-figure worker who walks to it and grabs on.
evidence: Timing and placement follow the film: in e.png the box grows steadily from frame 1 to 50 (g.png shows evenly stepped outlines with no gaps or reversals), matching the locomotive's approach in f.png 1-50; the stick figure walks left from about frame 14 and reaches the box's right corner by about frame 33, close to the film's man reaching the step at f.png 27-33. Weaknesses: (1) in f.png 27-40 the man crouches, reaches up and steps onto the front step, while in e.png 31-50 the figure only stands leaning against the corner with no reach, crouch or climb, so the boarding action is not performed; (2) the character silhouette is not the doodle's: c.png is a wide, low side-view body with a slanted front at right, a small arch door off-centre, and the chimney near the right; the animation is a tall near-square front-on box with a centred arch that fills most of the face, so only parts (arch, chimney cap, smoke, polygon wheels) carry over; (3) the smoke strokes are redrawn in a different shape every frame (e.g. e.png 5-8, 20-24, 44-47), a constant boil the film does not have, though minor.
primary_gap: The figure does not perform the film's key action of crouching, reaching for the handrail and stepping onto the locomotive's front step (f.png 27-40); it just walks up and stands against the corner.
closes_when: In e.png 27-40 the stick figure bends its knees and lowers, raises one arm to the box's right edge, then lifts one foot onto a step at the lower right corner and stays raised on it through frame 50 while the box keeps growing.
protect: The steady, gap-free growth of the vehicle matching the film's approach speed; the figure's left walk timed to arrive at the right corner around frame 30; the fixed grey scenery that the vehicle progressively covers; the doodle's chimney cap, two-stroke smoke, polygon wheels and loose single-line outline.
identity_gap: The doodle's wide, low side-view body with slanted right front and small off-centre arch door has been replaced by a tall square front-view box with a huge centred arch, so only the chimney, smoke and wheel marks identify it as the same drawing.
